text: My laptop screen keeps flickering after I dropped it yesterday. There is a crack near the hinge, and I have a presentation in an hour.
I can't get into the payroll portal since this morning. It says my password is wrong even after I reset it twice.
The office Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every few minutes on the second floor, but the wired computers seem fine.
The printer in reception is showing a paper jam, but I removed all the paper I can see and restarted it.
I'm furious that the shared drive disappeared again. Our whole team is blocked and the client files are due today.
My new headset microphone is not detected by Teams, though I can hear everyone else without a problem.
The VPN says connection timed out whenever I try to connect from home. It started after the laptop updated last night.
I spilled coffee on my keyboard and now several keys are typing by themselves. Please help, I have reports to finish.
The accounting application crashes whenever I export the monthly report to Excel.
The meeting room display says no signal when I plug in my laptop with the HDMI cable.
Our warehouse network is completely down and none of the scanners can reach the inventory system.
I accidentally deleted a folder from my desktop. Is there a way to get it back? It contained some old notes.
My laptop battery drains from full to empty in less than an hour, even when I close all my apps.
The browser keeps redirecting me to a blank page when I open the benefits website.
I am panicking because my computer is making a clicking noise and the screen just went blue with an error.
Could someone add the new intern to the marketing team's shared calendar? No rush, they start next week.
Emails to external customers are stuck in my outbox and haven't sent for the last 30 minutes.
My desk phone has no dial tone. I checked the cable and tried another wall jack.
The latest design software update removed the font menu we use, and I can't finish the brochure.
Several people on the third floor say video calls are freezing, but regular web browsing works.
